summary: Completed focused Phase 2 verification for retry/checkpoint recovery, ownership/claim, reader timing behavior, voice probes, PDF, and checkout smoke. Deterministic backend recovery/race suites now run and pass; key blocker remains payment provider config handling causing 502 on orders.

critical.issue: POST returns 502 for both Stripe and Midtrans paths. Backend logs show uncaught TypeError when STRIPE_API_KEY or MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY is None (payment client constructors/auth build fail).

minor.issue: Error surface is generic 502 HTML at preview edge; API should return explicit JSON configuration error (e.g., 503 payment not configured).

ui_bugs.issue: After page change, active sentence highlight was still present in one run (expected reset state).

integration_issues.issue: UI stays on checkout and shows error because /api/orders returns 502; no redirect to Stripe and no Midtrans token.

With fast fixture transitions, browser often landed directly on terminal state (reader/partial) before generating screen was visible; backend checkpoint/progress tests passed and terminal UI states were verified.

action_items: Guard payment provider initialization in /api/orders: if Stripe/Midtrans keys are missing, return explicit JSON 503 and avoid TypeError stack traces.
Re-verify reader highlight reset behavior across page-change and auto-next after payment blocker fix.
Optionally add deterministic UI progress transition harness with longer controlled delay so generating screen visibility is always captured before terminal switch.
critical_code_review_comments: test_phase2_api.py hygiene issue fixed: removed global auth_limits wipe and added scoped test data cleanup only for test-prefixed records.
Migration coverage now executes actual migrate_legacy.migrate() (idempotency verified) instead of duplicating update queries.
Duplicate route check added and currently passes: exactly one GET /api/auth/me and one POST /api/auth/logout.
test_credentials file is present but effectively empty; shared durable test accounts should be documented there for future agents.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_UI_* guest fixture stories/tokens for browser verification and cleaned them afterward using /app/tests/cleanup_phase2_ui_fixtures.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend deterministic recovery/race suites are now in place and green (21/21 in iteration2 xml + real voice probe pass). Browser confirmed guest-save claim isolation, legacy no-timestamp rendering, bilingual guest/progress/reset/voice labels, mobile 32-dot no overflow, and PDF download (non-empty; regex counted 9 /Type /Page objects). Remaining blocker is payments config handling (/api/orders 502 for both Stripe and Midtrans).
rca of the issue: Checkout failures reproduce consistently via UI and direct API. Root cause from backend.err.log: Stripe path crashes at StripeCheckout init when STRIPE_API_KEY is None (TypeError: 'NoneType' not iterable); Midtrans path crashes building BasicAuth when MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY is None (TypeError bytes expected). Endpoint catches exception and returns generic 502, causing frontend Cloudflare-style error response.
